title: Decide distribution channel: npm vs binary release vs hosted-first
description: Decide how Loreweaver will be distributed once a business/licensing decision is made. Options to evaluate: publishing @loreweaver/* packages to npm, shipping a packaged binary release (e.g. standalone CLI executable), or a hosted-first model where the core is delivered as a service rather than as installable packages. This decision gates removing the private guards and finalizing publish metadata (see loreweaver-0jq.26).
acceptance_criteria: A distribution channel (npm / binary release / hosted-first, or a combination) is chosen and recorded (ADR or bead note), with rationale and the implied changes to package privacy/publish metadata.
close_reason: Accepted GitHub Releases as the initial public CLI distribution channel. Do not publish npm packages initially; keep root and workspace package private guards in place. Release packaged CLI artifacts for non-commercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, including required license/commercial-rights notices and any applicable third-party content notices. Do not publish @eshyra/core or treat it as a public SDK. npm publication may be reconsidered later only with an explicit developer-distribution and SDK/package support decision. Hosted service remains a future product direction, not the initial CLI distribution channel.
